summary: Events, recurrence, alarms, ICS import/export and reminders exist inside the shell and the Calendar and Reminders apps. No app-facing SDK API (no calendar module in springboard/sdk/src), so third-party apps cannot read or write calendar data.

features.note: shared file store for shell, lock widgets and Today; no SDK store object, no permission prompt
title, location, notes, date, duration, all-day; titles capped at 160 chars; no URL, availability or structured attendees
app-internal file store (store.rs); no SDK access
ICS import/export and colour plates; no account sources (CalDAV, Exchange) in the store model
no attendee or invitation model found
RRULE subset FREQ, INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH, EXDATE; app-internal, not SDK; reminders have own repeat.rs
relative-offset alerts posted as notifications; no absolute or proximity alarms
design for a scheduler service used by Reminders and Calendar
Wave 4 (theme-19, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no geofence or structured location found

Wave 4 (w4-eventkit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. shell polls store generation; no app-facing change notification
MiniMonth and Gregorian grids only; no event edit or chooser view controllers

Wave 4 (w4-eventkit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no error domain; store validates via CalendarEvent::valid

gaps: No SDK calendar/reminder API for apps
No permission model for calendar access
No attendees, invitations or account sources
